product.name: Regular-Fit Sleeveless Sports Hoodie with DryMove™
product.description: Regular-fit, sleeveless sports hoodie in functional fabric made with DryMove™ to wick away moisture from skin and keep you comfortably dry while moving. Mesh-lined, drawstring hood and a straight-cut hem with slit at sides.
